description.excerpt: \Drupal\file\Element\ManagedFile::valueCallback() now validates #file_value_callbacks entries the same way core validates #process , #pre_render , and other render callbacks. Previously, #file_value_callbacks executed any callable directly, bypassing the protections added by #2966327: Limit what can be called by a callback in render arrays to reduce the risk of RCE . This allowed arbitrary code execution if untrusted input reached this property. Each callback must now be one of: A method tagged with the \Drupal\Core\Security\Attribute\TrustedCallback attribute.
